issue.title: bob ref create can mint ids that differ from stems and collide across ref types
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs` reference ID allocation, output naming, and default-target collision walk

With `bob ref create` and `--output`, choose an output basename that differs from the generated base stem and inspect the note frontmatter and PDF marker: the id remains the base stem. Also create same-stem references in different type directories; the default collision walk is scoped per type directory and can leave duplicate ids across `ref/`.

The created reference id must match its note stem, with a numeric suffix only to avoid a duplicate across the whole `ref/` directory. Violations break `bob ref find`, preserve mismatches that `bob ref rename` then has to repair, and allow ambiguous IDs.

task_type_fields.impact: Creates reference IDs that diverge from filenames or duplicate across ref/, breaking lookup and the vault identity rule.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs reference ID allocation and output naming
task_type_fields.repro: Run bob ref create with --output whose basename differs from its base stem; then create same-stem refs across type directories. Compare note id, PDF marker id, and note basenames across the whole ref directory.

issue.creation_reason: The approved rename implementation surfaced two creation paths that still violate the vault-wide reference ID rule. They need a separate create-side fix, which is intentionally outside this rename change.
